original: お〜い、ティーンティーン！
traducao: Heeey, Tyyy-Tyyy!

original: ちょっとぉ、無視しないでよ。\nティンティン！！
traducao: Heyyy, don't ignore me!\nTy-Ty!!

original: あ？　\nおれの事呼んでたのか？
traducao: Huh?\nWere you calling me?

original: 当たり前でしょ。\n他に誰がいるってのよ
traducao: Of course!\nWho else would it be?

original: あんな呼び方でわかるわけねぇだろ！
traducao: How am I supposed to know with that name?!

original: 何でよ〜。\nぶー
traducao: Why not~?\nBoo.

original: ティトレイだから、ティンティンでしょ。\n察してよ、それで
traducao: You're Tytree, so you're Ty-Ty!\nFigure it out already!

original: 無理言うなよ！
traducao: Don't ask the impossible!

original: はいはい、わかったわかった
traducao: Yeah, yeah, alright, alright.

original: そんな事より、あたしのストロー見なかった？
traducao: Anyway, seen my straw around?

original: そんな事って……。\n見てねぇよ、お前の武器なんて！
traducao: "Anyway"...?\nI haven't seen your weapon!

original: そっかぁ……。\nじゃ、他を当たってみるわ。\nじゃーね、ティンティン
traducao: I see...\nGuess I'll check elsewhere.\nSee ya, Ty-Ty!

original: だから、その呼び方止めろって！
traducao: I told you to stop calling me that!

original: えー、せっかく気に入ってたのに……。\nじゃぁねぇ、ティトレイだから
traducao: Aww, and I liked it so much...\nWell then, since you're Tytree...

original: 「トイレっち」で、どう？
traducao: How about "Toilet-kins"?

original: もう、怒る気も無くなってきた……
traducao: I don't even have energy to get mad...

original: うそうそ〜。\n真に受けないの。\n「トレっち」、ね、これでいいでしょ？
traducao: Kidding, kidding~\nDon't take it so seriously.\n"Ty-kins", alright? Happy now?

original: あー、もう何でもいいよ……
traducao: Ah, whatever, call me what you want...

original: じゃ、あたし、行くよ。\nまたね、ティンティ……
traducao: Well, I'm off then.\nSee ya, Ty-T--

original: じゃなくて、トレっち∀
traducao: I mean, Ty-kins!

original: お〜、ジェージェー！\n久しぶり〜
traducao: Oh, Jay-Jay!\nLong time no see~

original: ノーマさんも、お変わりない様ですね
traducao: You haven't changed either, Norma.

original: 色々な意味で
traducao: In more ways than one.

original: ちょっとあんた。\nそれどーゆー意味よ？
traducao: Hey, you!\nWhat's that supposed to mean?

original: 言葉通りの意味ですが
traducao: Exactly what the words mean.

original: 通じない辺りが\nいかにもノーマさんらしいですね
traducao: Not understanding it is just so\ncharacteristic of you, Norma.

original: 何だとこらァ〜〜！
traducao: Why you little punk--!

original: やめんか、二人とも
traducao: Knock it off, both of you.

original: みょごっ
traducao: Myogoh!

original: 何でぼくまで……
traducao: Why me too...?

original: 遊びに来ているのではないだろう。\nここには各国の要人もいらっしゃるのだ
traducao: We are not here to play.\nVIPs from various nations are present.

original: 悪ふざけも程々にする様に。\nいいな？
traducao: Keep your horseplay in moderation.\nUnderstood?

original: ぬぐぐ〜〜……わかったわよう
traducao: Grrr... Fine, I got it.

original: ここでガッポガッポ稼いで、\n今にウィルっちをギャフンと\n言わせてやるんだから〜！
traducao: I'll rake in loads of Gald here,\nand make Will-power eat his words,\njust you wait!

original: ギャフン
traducao: His words.

original: あんたが言うなっての！
traducao: Not you, stupid!

original: わぁぁっ！\nちょっ、これは一体どういう……！
traducao: Waaah!\nWait, what on earth is this...?!

original: その……ロックスの肉球は\nとても良い手触りだと\nプレセアからうかがいました
traducao: Um... I heard from Presea that\nRocks' paw pads have a wonderful\ntexture to the touch.

original: ですから、その……
traducao: And so, um...

original: わ……私達とも、握手してくれないか？
traducao: W-Would you shake hands with us too?

original: 肉球って、ぷにぷになんだよね。\nすっごく気持ちいいんだろうね〜♪
traducao: Paw pads are squishy, aren't they?\nThey must feel so nice to squeeze~

original: えっと……わ、私は……
traducao: Um... I-I just...

original: ま、待って下さい！
traducao: P-Please wait a moment!

original: そんな事急に言われて\n皆さんで押しかけられても……
traducao: To have everyone crowd me all at once\nwith such a sudden request...

original: それに僕にも、仕事が……
traducao: Besides, I have work to do...

original: は〜い、押さない押さな〜い。\n順番に並んで〜！
traducao: Alright, no pushing, no shoving!\nLine up in an orderly fashion~!

original: 握手一回、５００ガルド！\n５００ガルドぽっきりだよ〜！
traducao: One handshake, 500 Gald!\nA flat 500 Gald only~!

original: って、ノーマ様！
traducao: Wait, Lady Norma!

original: どさくさに紛れて\nお金儲けしないで下さい！！
traducao: Please do not make a profit\noff of this chaos!!

original: ねーねー。\nチェスとドロんってさ、\n似た者同士だよね〜？
traducao: Hey, hey.\nChes-kins and Woody are two\nof a kind, aren't they~?

original: なぜ、そう思うのかな？
traducao: Whatever makes you think so?

original: どこも似てないだろ？\n髪型だって、着てる服だって
traducao: We're nothing alike!\nNot our hair, not the clothes we wear!

original: そだね。\n言葉遣いも、溢れる気品も\nドロんの方が上だよね
traducao: True that.\nWoody's way ahead in speech\nand brimming elegance!

original: んだよ、それ！
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?!

original: なんつーのかなぁ……
traducao: How should I put it...

original: こう、がーっとなってて、\nぐぃーって感じのとこっていうの？
traducao: Like, how you go all "whaaam",\nand then "swoooosh", ya know?

original: ね？　\nソフィたん？
traducao: Right?\nLittle Sophie?
Staaaaare...

original: ありゃ、どっか行っちゃってるわ
traducao: Oops, she spaced out completely.

original: やっほぉおぉい！！\nガルドめっけ〜〜〜♪♪
traducao: Yaaaay-hoooo!!\nFound some Gald~~~!

original: いやぁ、今日はいい事ありそうな\n予感がするねえ∀　\nむふふふ∀∀
traducao: Man, I've got a hunch something great\nis gonna happen today!\nHehehe!

original: 何よ〜、ベルベル。\nどったの？
traducao: What's up, Bel-bel?\nSomething wrong?

original: はっ……。\nまさか、このガルドが欲しいの？\nそうなのね！？
traducao: Gasp...!\nDon't tell me you want this Gald?!\nThat's it, isn't it?!

original: いや、そうじゃないよ
traducao: No, that's not it.

original: ……ノーマを見てると、時々\n知り合いの事を思い出すんだよな……
traducao: ...Looking at you, Norma, I sometimes\nremember an acquaintance of mine...

original: うん……似てる
traducao: Yeah... Similar.

original: ほほ〜〜う。\n知り合いとな？
traducao: Ohooo~\nAn acquaintance, you say?

original: なになに、どんな人なわけ？\nもっと詳しく教えてよ〜〜
traducao: Tell me, what kind of person are they?\nGive me all the juicy details~~

original: ……って、ソフィたん？\n何で逃げるのさ
traducao: ...Wait, Little Sophie?\nWhy are you backing away?

original: ……触られるのかと思ったから
traducao: ...I thought you were gonna touch me.

original: 触る！？　\nどこをっ？
traducao: Touch you!?\nWhere?!

original: いや……気にしないでくれ。\n知り合いを重ねて見てるだけなんだ……
traducao: No... Don't worry about it.\nI was just projecting a friend onto you...

original: ノーマの武器って変わってるよね
traducao: Your weapon is pretty unusual, Norma.

original: うん。　ジーニアスのけん玉もすごいけど\nストローで戦うなんて\nなかなか出来る事じゃないよね
traducao: Yeah. Genis's kendama is neat, but\nfighting with a straw is something\nnot just anyone can pull off!

original: も〜〜、ミルミルったら！\nそんなに褒めたって、\n何にも出ないんだかんね∀
traducao: Aww, Mil-mil!\nPraising me that much won't get you\nanything, you know~!

original: でも、どうしてシャボン玉で\n敵にダメージを与えられるの？
traducao: Still, how do soap bubbles\ndeal damage to enemies?

original: およ。　\nマルちんったらいい質問！\nそんなのアレに決まってんでしょ〜♪
traducao: Oho! Great question,\nMar-tin! It could only be\nthat, of course~!

original: なになに？
traducao: Ooh, tell me, tell me!

original: や、毒だから。\nシャボン液
traducao: Well, it's poison.\nThe soap liquid.

original: ええぇ〜〜っ！？
traducao: Whaaaat!?!

original: うーん
traducao: Hmm...

original: 声じゃないし……。\n考え方、というわけでも……
traducao: It's not the voice...\nNor their way of thinking, either...

original: ちょっとちょっと〜。\nさっきからどったの、二人して？
traducao: Hold on, hold on~\nWhat's up with the two of you?

original: あ……今、シェリアと話しててね、\nアスベルとウッドロウって、何だか\n雰囲気が似てるねって話になって……
traducao: Ah... Cheria and I were talking,\nsaying Asbel and Woodrow kind of have\na similar vibe, and...

original: でも、どこが似てるか\nさっぱりわからないのよね
traducao: Yet we have no idea\nwhere that similarity comes from.

original: こう、外見的な特徴じゃなくて、\nイメージ的に似ている部分が\nある様な気がするんだけど……
traducao: It's not their physical traits,\nbut more like a shared impression\nthat they give off...

original: あ〜。\nひょっとして
traducao: Aaah.\nCould it be...

original: 幸薄そうなとこじゃない？
traducao: That they both look totally unlucky?

original: ……それだ！
traducao: ...That's it!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

traducao: Anger.\n
